name: alerts
sql: select condition, is_open, opened_at, last_sent_at, updated_at from public.postmatch_alerts

name: alert_log
sql: select at, condition, kind, delivered, left(message,140) msg from public.postmatch_alert_log where at > '2026-09-27T01:40:00Z' order by at

name: dispatches
sql: select d.sent_at, r.status_code from public.postmatch_dispatch_log d left join net._http_response r on r.id=d.request_id where d.sent_at > '2026-09-27T01:40:00Z' order by d.sent_at

name: checker
sql: select status, return_message, start_time from cron.job_run_details where jobid=(select jobid from cron.job where jobname='ten270-oddspapi-postmatch-check') order by start_time desc limit 3

name: missed
sql: select count(*) filter (where d.sent_at > '2026-09-25T02:08:00Z' and d.sent_at < '2026-09-27T01:45:00Z') cron_attempts_in_gap from public.postmatch_dispatch_log d
